tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Save free-text memory content for a conversation; respects the conversation policy.

tools.name: memory_fact_save
tools.description: Save a structured fact (key/value) for a conversation under the long-term layer.

tools.name: memory_fact_load
tools.description: Load a structured fact by key for a conversation.

tools.name: memory_recent
tools.description: Return the most recent memory rows for a conversation.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Substring search over stored memory rows for a conversation.

tools.name: memory_search_layered
tools.description: Search memory rows with explicit layer scoping (stm/ltm/system).

tools.name: memory_search_fts
tools.description: Full-text search over memory rows; honours the conversation retrieval policy.

tools.name: memory_autosave_hook
tools.description: Internal hook used by the auto-save pipeline; never invoked directly by the assistant.

tools.name: memory_graph_search
tools.description: Search the memory knowledge graph for nodes matching a query.

tools.name: memory_graph_neighbors
tools.description: Return the neighbouring nodes/edges of a memory graph node.

tools.name: memory_graph_stats
tools.description: Return aggregate statistics for the memory knowledge graph.

tools.name: memory_graph_save
tools.description: Persist a graph fragment (nodes/edges) to the memory knowledge graph.

tools.name: graph_add_node
tools.description: Add a single node to the memory knowledge graph.

tools.name: graph_find_duplicate_nodes
tools.description: Maintenance scan that locates duplicate nodes in the memory graph.

tools.name: graph_merge_nodes
tools.description: Maintenance operation that merges duplicate nodes in the memory graph.

tools.name: graph_delete_orphan_nodes
tools.description: Maintenance operation that deletes orphan nodes from the memory graph.

tools.name: graph_prune_weak_edges
tools.description: Maintenance operation that prunes low-weight edges from the memory graph.

tools.name: memory_semantic_save
tools.description: Persist an embedded semantic chunk for retrieval.

tools.name: memory_semantic_search
tools.description: Vector-based semantic search over embedded memory chunks; honours the retrieval policy.

tools.name: memory_embedding_version_status
tools.description: Report the active embedding-model version and backfill status.

tools.name: memory_embedding_backfill
tools.description: Maintenance operation that backfills embeddings for unembedded memory rows.

tools.name: workspace_save
tools.description: Store a workspace entry for a conversation.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List workspace entries with optional conversation and type filters.

tools.name: workspace_get
tools.description: Read one workspace entry by identifier.

tools.name: workspace_update
tools.description: Update the content of one workspace entry.

tools.name: workspace_delete
tools.description: Delete one workspace entry by identifier.
